instruction: Help me view the first website link in the most recent email from the Bills folder by opening it in Chrome.

metadata.explanation: Variation 9: Polite phrasing with 'help me view'. Task requires opening the first website link (https://www.amazon.com/) from the most recent Bills folder email in Chrome. Evaluator checks that all three expected URLs are present in open tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator checks for exact set equality of all three URLs (apple.com, scholar.google.com, amazon.com), but instruction only requires opening the first link from Bills email (amazon.com)

The metric 'is_expected_tabs' requires ALL three URLs to be open. If user closes the pre-existing tabs (apple.com, scholar.google.com), verification fails even though instruction only asks to 'view the first website link'
Instruction says 'view the first website link' which semantically means opening amazon.com, NOT maintaining all existing tabs in their initial state
No verification that user actually found the correct email or extracted the first link - only checks final tab state
Missing postconfig to ensure Thunderbird remains accessible for verification (though this task only verifies Chrome state)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change evaluator to check that amazon.com is present in open tabs (using partial match logic), not exact set equality of all three URLs
Use a metric that checks 'contains expected URL' rather than 'exact list equality' - e.g., check that at least one tab has URL matching amazon.com
Alternative: Update instruction to explicitly state 'keep all existing tabs open while viewing the link' to match current evaluator logic
Consider using is_expected_active_tab metric to verify amazon.com is the active tab, better matching the 'view' semantic
